meta.name: google-image-search
meta.description: Search and download images via Google Custom Search API with LLM-powered selection. This skill should be used when finding images for articles, presentations, research documents, or enriching Obsidian notes with relevant visuals. Supports simple queries, batch processing from JSON config, automatic config generation from terms, and full note enrichment with automatic image insertion below headings.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索并下载配图，自动插入文章或笔记
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果写文章或做笔记时需要快速找到并插入相关图片
copy.tagline_en: Search and download images, auto-insert into articles or notes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly find and insert relevant images into articles or notes

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能通过 Google Custom Search API 搜索并下载图片，并用 AI 挑选最合适的图片。支持单次查询、批量处理、从关键词生成配置，以及自动为 Obsidian 笔记配图。
howto.when: 当你需要为文章、演示或笔记找配图时，可以要求 Claude 搜索图片。也支持批量搜索多个主题，或自动从笔记中提取关键词并插入图片。

say.text: 帮我搜索一张“神经接口可穿戴设备”的图片，下载到 ./images 文件夹。
say.note: Claude 会执行单次查询并下载图片。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can search and download images via Google Custom Search API with AI-powered selection. Supports single queries, batch processing, config generation from terms, and automatic image insertion into Obsidian notes.
howto.when_en: When you need images for articles, presentations, or notes. Also supports batch search for multiple topics or automatic extraction and insertion from Obsidian notes.

say_en.text: Search for an image of 'neural interface wearable device' and download to ./images.
say_en.note: Claude will perform a single query and download.

say_en.text: Generate image search config from terms: AlterEgo wearable, sEMG electrodes, BCI headset.
say_en.note: Claude will create a JSON config for batch use.
